rationale_text: Evaluation succeeded | Criterion 1 passed: After the user abandoned course selection, the agent answered directly that enrollment and place confirmation depend on the school office, without insisting on collecting the language, level or format. | Criterion 2 passed: The agent did not claim a guaranteed place, booking or completed enrollment. It correctly stated that the school office is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00, without inventing contact channels. | Criterion 3 passed: The agent correctly adapted to the user's new request, responding relevantly about enrollment and place confirmation without insisting on the previous course-selection flow. | Criterion 4 passed: All customer-facing messages are in Brazilian Portuguese, understandable and relevant. There are no self-instructions, internal comments or meaningless sequences in responses to the customer. | The simulated user ended the conversation. | The optional tool was not called.
